annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Union Commission, Information and Communication Directorate
key_provisions_or_claims: African ICT ministers endorsed the Continental AI Strategy and African Digital Compact on 13 June 2024.
Strategy calls for an Africa-owned, people-centred, development-oriented and inclusive approach to AI.
Priorities include infrastructure, talent, datasets, innovation, partnerships and an AI-ready regulatory environment.
Ministers mandated the AU to organise a Continental AI Summit.
Both documents go to the AU Executive Council in July 2024 for adoption.
annotation.summary_en: African Union press release on African ICT ministers endorsing the Continental AI Strategy and African Digital Compact in June 2024. It stresses an Africa-owned, inclusive approach to AI for development, capacity building and a role in global digital governance, pending AU Executive Council adoption. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: African Ministers Adopt Landmark Continental Artificial Intelligence Strategy, African Digital Compact to drive Africa's Development and Inclusive Growth
